༄༅/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo mū la gu ru pa raṃ pa rā ya// 'chi ba dran cing don gnyis sgrub 'dod pas// nyin mtshan bar med chos dang rang rgyud bsre| |de tsam gyis ngal brtson zhan rnams kyis kyang*// nyin mtshan thun bzhir nyams len snying por dril// bde ba'i stan 'dug rlung bsal skyabs sems mthar// rang lus yi dam 'ja' tshon chu zla bzhin// gsal rdzogs snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// mdun mkhar mi 'jigs bzhi ldan seṅge'i khrir// chags bral padma gdung sel zla ba dang*// ma rig mun 'joms rta bdun dbang po'i steng*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang chos tshogs rtsa ba gsum// kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// chos kyi grags pa chos sku 'gyur med zhal// longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa'i rgyan// gang 'dul sprul sku dkar dmar mdangs ldan pa// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos gos rnam gsum 'chang*// thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// bka' rtags sgom zhwa dbang gi mdog can mnabs// srid zhi'i mtha' spangs rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// gcig dang du mar sku yi cho 'phrul 'gyed// ston 'khor dbyer med brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// mchog gsum yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ */sprin dang na bun ji bzhin bar med gtams// de ltar bsgoms pa rten 'byung tsam las gzhan// bdag dang bla ma gnyis med ngo bor gcig /ces gsal btab/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug la// bdag lus ngag yid phyi nang gsang gsum gyi// dngos por grub dgu mchod pa'i rdzas su 'bul// mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i rang bzhin gcig /mtha' bral ro mnyam chen por 'bul lags na// bya rtsol bral ba'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes mchod/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus pa// gcig bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma rje// mthong thos dran reg gang 'brel ba// don ldan khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so// rje btsun dkon mchog phun tshogs la gsol ba 'debs so| |rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la gsol ba 'debs so// sngags 'chang che mchog 'dus pa la gsol ba 'debs so// rigs gtso mi bskyod rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// mtshungs med padma badzra la gsol ba 'debs so// 'chi med buddha tshe dbang la gsol ba 'debs so// mgon po thugs kyi rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// kun 'dus rtag pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// dbur smyon grub pa'i dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs so// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig

/snying med tha mal pa bdag gis| |dal 'byor rnyed dka' ru bsgoms kyang*// mi tshe stong zad du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// mi rtag 'chi ba ru bsgoms kyang*| |'dus byas rtag 'dzin du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// rgyu 'bras bslu med du bsgoms kyang*// blang dor go log tu thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal du bsgoms kyang*// ngan song bgrod thabs su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// so thar sdom pa ru bsrungs kyang*// spong sems nges 'byung dang bral lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// 'gro kun pha ma ru bsgoms kyang*// chags sdang dgra gnyen du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// byams dang snying rje ru bsgoms kyang*// zhe sdang 'khon 'dzin du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// smon 'jug byang sems su bsgoms kyang*| |rang bde don gnyer du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// rang lus lha sku ru bsgoms kyang*// tha mal snang zhen du thal lo| |thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// bzlas brjod sngags grangs su bcad kyang*// srog rtsol rgya yan du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// ting 'dzin chu zla ltar bsgoms kyang*// a 'thas gdos bcas su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// rjes gzhig ril 'dzin ltar bsdus kyang*// go yul gshar sbyang du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig

/snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// rang sems spros bral du bsgoms kyang*// 'dzin stangs blos byas su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// gang shar 'dzin med du bsgoms kyang*// dran rtsis rgyas 'debs su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// zung 'jug blo 'das su bsgoms kyang*| /gnyis 'dzin phyogs lhung du thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// rang babs bcos min du bsgoms kyang*// bcos min lhan thabs su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// 'khor gsum yongs dag tu bsngos kyang*// lo 'dod khe grags su thal lo// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig /snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// mos gus rtse gcig tu bsgoms kyang*// yin min dga' sdug gis khyer ro// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig |snying med tha mal pa bdag gis// 'di phyi thams cad kyi skyabs mgon// 'khor ba'i gcong 'byin gyi sman pa// nyon mongs dgra 'joms kyi dpa' bo// mi shes mun sel gyi nyi ma| |sdug bsngal tshad skyob kyi zla ba// dgos 'dod re skong gi nor bu// kun 'dus gcig chog gi bla ma// gsol ba snying khung nas 'debs so// thugs rjes myur mgyogs su gzigs la// byin rlabs 'bad med du stsol cig /don gnyis lhun grub kyi dga' ston// stan thog 'di nyid du stsol cig /skal ldan mos gus can bdag gi// re ba sa stong du ma bzhag |mos gus don med du ma gtong*// gsol 'debs yal bar du ma 'dor// thugs rjes btang snyoms su ma bzhag /'di phyi bar do yi skyabs mgon// khyod nyid gcig pu las med do// skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang*// re sa khyod nyid las med do// thugs rje'i spyan rgyang gis gzigs shig

/bla ma mkhyen no// bla ma mkhyen no// bla ma mkhyen no// zhes rang rgyud dang 'dre nges shes par bya/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po ma skyes kyi bar du 'bad/ nam mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po skyes pa de'i tshe/ dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ kyai/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyod kyi// mdzod spu'i dbyings nas 'od dkar zer spros// bdag gi dpral bar thim ma thag tu// lus dang sad pa'i sgrib pa rab sbyangs// sprul skur smin byas sku yi rdo rje// bla ma'i sku dang bdag lus dbyer med// snang stong rdo rje kā ya siddhi// kyai/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyod kyi// mgul gyi dbyings nas 'od dmar zer spros// bdag gi mgrin par thim ma thag tu// ngag dang rmi lam sgrib pa rab sbyangs// longs skur smin byas gsung gi rdo rje// bla ma'i gsung dang bdag ngag dbyer med// grag stong rdo rje wāka siddhi// kyai/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyod kyi| |thugs ka'i dbyings nas 'od mthing zer spros// bdag gi snying khar thim ma thag tu// yid dang gnyid 'thug sgrib pa rab sbyangs// chos skur smin byas thugs kyi rdo rje// bla ma'i thugs dang bdag sems dbyer med// gsal stong rdo rje tsitta siddhi// kyai/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyod kyi// lte ba'i dbyings nas 'od ser zer spros// bdag gi lte bar thim ma thag tu| |cha mnyam 'pho ba'i sgrib pa rab sbyangs// ngo bo nyid skur smin par byas nas// ye shes rdo rje rnam pa gsum dang*// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med// bde stong rdo rje sarba siddhi| |kyai/ 'khor tshogs me long ha bzhin 'dus te// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la thim zhing*// de yang dgyes bzhin 'od lnga'i gong bu// nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ltar 'bar ba// bdag la thim pas bdag lus 'od gong*// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i mod la// 'od gsal stong chen mkha' dang 'ja' tshon// ji bzhin gsal stong zung 'jug mnyam yangs// spros bral ye 'byams dbu phyag rdzogs chen// ming la ma gol don kun dbyer med// zung 'jug ye shes e waṃ mā yā// a la la hoḥ

zhes pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// zhes pa'ang dad pa dang dag snang gi nor gyis phyug pa'i bla ma dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas mgyogs par bris pa ste/ rang la yid rton pa'i slob ma rnams kyis yi dam du byos shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
